questions.question: If 16 January 2015 was Friday, then what was the day of the week on 16 January 2010?
questions.solution:
Given: 16 January 2015 was Friday.

The same date occurs on the next day of the week every year. So if we want to calculate in back date we have to count backward:

 
• 16 January 2015 was Friday.
 
• 16 January 2014 was Thursday.
 
• 16 January 2013 was Wednesday.
 
• 16 January 2012 was Monday (It is a leap year with 2 odd days so it will not be Tuesday).
 
• 16 January 2011 was Sunday.
 
• **16 January 2010 was Saturday.**

Hence **the correct answer is option 4.**

We apply the pattern to the given series:

 __**32 - 15**__ = 17 i.e. 1,7

2) (20, 2, 7, 47)

 __47____ - 20__ = 27 i.e. 2,7

3) (13, 3, 7, 50)

 __50 - 13__ = 37 i.e. 3,7

4) (7, 4, ?, 48)

 __48 - 7__ = 41 i.e. 4,1 

So, **? = 1**.

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**

questions.question:
‘A # B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

If P & Q @ D # K @ S # T, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?

options.text: D is the daughter-in-law of T.
P is the daughter of K.
S is the maternal grandfather of Q.
T is the mother of K.

questions.solution:
From the given information:

‘A # B’ means ‘A is the husband of B’.

‘A @ B’ means ‘A is the daughter of B’.

‘A & B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

We substitute the values in the given equation:

P is the sister of Q, Q is the daughter of D, D is the husband of K, K is the daughter of S, S is the husband of T.

Now we draw a tree using the symbols:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/abf25944776d2a3ecedfc8ce453d6240c47cfde66b9c3a1ec4348e9237131af8.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c8b953ff8b5e4dae6b8ec1ea26cba75ca9fc9b68318bbd1713b1b2b2daa92e04.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) D is the daughter-in-law of T - **False (**D is the son- in-low of T**)**

Option 2) P is the daughter of K - **True**

Option 3) S is the maternal grandfather of Q - **True**

Option 4) T is the mother of K - **True**

Hence **the correct answer is option 1)**

questions.question:
If ‘A’ denotes ‘addition’, ‘B’ denotes ‘multiplication‘, ‘C’ denotes ‘subtraction’ and ‘D’ denotes ‘division’, then what will be the value of the following expression?

55 A 5 B (7 A 4) C 75 D (25 D 5) = ?
questions.solution:
From the given information:

‘A’ denotes ‘addition’

‘B’ denotes ‘multiplication‘

‘C’ denotes ‘subtraction’

‘D’ denotes ‘division’

Now we substitute the values in the given equation and solve using BODMAS rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8a6f93b0f8305d496162d41f65450f13e20c650df2dbe481929271174df469e9.png] 

55 + 5 × (__**7 + 4**__) - 75 ÷ (__**25 **____**÷**____** 5**__) = ?

55 + 5 × 11 - __**75 ÷ 5**__ = ?

55 + __**5 × 11**__ - 15 = ?

__**55 + **55__ - 15 = ?

__**110 - 15**__ = ?

**95 = Answer**

Hence **the correct answer is option 4)**

questions.question: Suyash starts walking from his office and walks 40 m towards the south. From there, he turns right and walks 35 m, and then he turns right again and walks 70 m. Finally, he turns right one more time and walks 75 m to reach his home. What is the shortest distance between his office and his home?
questions.solution:
From the given information:

Step 1:Suyash starts walking from his office and walks 40 m towards the south. From there, he turns right and walks 35 m.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/08e3b02af3810820d62e85b17899d21da13deeeb905d8eec52289248d5d038a7.png] 

Step 2: Then he turns right again and walks 70 m. Finally, he turns right one more time and walks 75 m to reach his home.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0873fbc4a7de006dcd1801cb50939c28f80a2bf9ce5a0b867172af2802b0dd1b.png] 

Now we calculate the distance from home to office:

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/fc092e3ff6e2028e0e75c0d265f81c5a462ef705704c952b1f0d95ec5493cb02.png] 

Here we apply the formula: Hypotenuse = √(Base)² + (Perpendicular)² 

Hypotenuse = √(30)2 + (40)2

Hypotenuse = √900 + 1600

Hypotenuse = √2500 

**Hypotenuse = 50**

Hence **the correct answer is option 3)**
